title: A novel approach to dry weight adjustments for dialysis patients using machine learning.
summary: The retrospective single-center study used XGBoost on 1,672 hemodialysis patients to estimate clinically set dry weight from clinical features including bioimpedance; reported average accuracy was 83% within 1 kg and 72% within 2 kg. This supports a limited retrospective estimation result, not improved patient outcomes or external generalization.
